soldier: The soldier has the head yellowish brown, the base of the mandibles brown and the tips purplish brown, labrum, antennae and pronotum pale yellowish brown, abdomen and legs pale yellow. Head elongate-cylindrical, about 1.1 times as wide as high, the lateral margins parallel, the posterior margin straight. In profile the dorsal angle of the frons slightly projecting, the frontal slope about 45 degrees, the dorsal margin of the head almost straight, the ventral margin of the postmentum sloping downwards forwards from the waist region; the frontal surface nearly flat, the anterior arm of the Y-shaped suture faintly visible, ocelli and compound eyes indistinct. Labrum flat and square, its tip slightly arched outwards. The tips of the mandibles slightly curved, the left mandible more than half as long as the head capsule, the tip of the first marginal tooth of the right mandible directed laterally. Antennae with 11–12 segments. The postmentum about six to seven times as long as the width at the waist, its widest region in the anterior third, the waist region in the posterior third. Pronotum distinctly narrower than the head, its anterior margin nearly straight or shallowly concave, with a small median notch, the lateral margins rounded, the posterior margin formed by two intersecting arcs.
